name: zopt_get_cursor_mode
description: zOpt::GetCursorMode reads the cursor bit from the shared game-control options word.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this accessor; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zGame options source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x407eb0 validates returning bit 2 of ZOPT_GAME_CONTROL_OPTIONS shifted to 0 or 1.
The native smoke verifies both set and clear reads through the cursor option path.
